correctness.rationale: The stabilizer of a finite ordered set S in Aut(Q,<) independently acts transitively on each of its k+1 dense open gaps. Invariance and equivalence transitivity force each gap to be entirely discrete singleton classes or one collapsed block; a discrete gap cannot merge externally. Selecting j collapsed gaps and a set partition of the k+j named units yields F_k=sum_j binom(k+1,j)B_(k+j), including F_0=2. The standard least finite-support theorem for the ordered-atom symmetry justifies inclusion-exclusion for exact essential supports H_k=sum_t (-1)^(k-t)binom(k,t)F_t. Log-convexity and the Bell-ratio asymptotic give 1-H_k/F_k <= k B_(k-1)/B_(k+1)=O((log k)^2/k). Independent Bell convolutions and finite proxy orbit checks reproduced first counts; a finite proxy does not prove the Q homogeneous-action argument.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not replace the stated infinite proof or establish correctness of assumptions outside the precise theorem domain.
